verdict.rationale: The pack documents no transaction or velocity limits, no holds on suspicious activity, and no account freezes or reinstatement paths, whether per account or per program. What it does show is adjacent: account holds that reserve funds for known future activity, optional team approval on ACH transfers, and real-time card authorization webhooks that a developer could use to build their own controls. None of these is the risk-control capability the story asks for.

support.subject: As an ops user, I can set risk controls per account and per program — transaction and velocity limits, holds on suspicious activity, and account freezes with documented reinstatement paths
